title: PrefixAgent: An LLM-Powered Design Framework for Efficient Prefix Adder Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2507.06127v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prefix adders are fundamental arithmetic circuits, but their design space grows exponentially with bit-width, posing significant optimization challenges. Previous works face limitations in performance, generalization, and scalability. To address these challenges, we propose PrefixAgent, an LLM-powered framework that enables efficient prefix adder optimization. Firstly, we reformulate the problem into two subtasks, namely backbone synthesis and structure refinement, which effectively reduce the search space. The LLM performs these two phases of optimization by invoking tools through function calls, enabling it to iteratively construct the backbone and refine local structures based on reasoning and EDA feedback. Secondly, this new design perspective allows us to systematically collect large-scale, high-quality supervision data. translated_title: PrefixAgent：一种基于大语言模型的加法器前缀优化高效设计框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.06127v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：前缀加法器是基本的算术电路，但其设计空间随位宽呈指数级增长，带来了显著的优化挑战。以往的研究在性能、泛化能力和可扩展性方面存在局限性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PrefixAgent，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，能够实现高效的前缀加法器优化。首先，我们将问题重新表述为两个子任务，即骨干合成和结构细化，这有效缩小了搜索空间。LLM通过函数调用调用工具来执行这两个优化阶段，使其能够基于推理和EDA反馈迭代地构建骨干并细化局部结构。其次，这种新的设计视角使我们能够系统地收集大规模、高质量的监督数据。我们利用e-graph的重写和等式饱和能力，全面探索设计空间，从而为模型训练提供丰富样本。
tldr: 本文提出PrefixAgent框架，利用大语言模型将前缀加法器优化分解为骨干合成和结构细化两个子任务，通过工具调用和e-graph数据收集，显著提升优化效率与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PrefixAgent, an LLM-powered framework that decomposes prefix adder optimization into backbone synthesis and structure refinement, leveraging tool calls and e-graph data collection to enhance optimization efficiency and scalability.
